item.title: Brown Awards $4.5 Million to Train Rhode Island Health Care and Factory Workers
item.description: Four Rhode Island nonprofits and institutions will expand training for nursing aides, medical assistants, machinists and early childhood clinicians.

item.title: Kingston Station Bridge Replacement Begins Tonight, Changing Route 138 Access
item.description: RIDOT shifts Route 138 traffic in South Kingstown tonight as a two-stage rebuild of the bridge over the rail line gets underway, with completion set for 2028.

item.title: Newport's The Elms Opens a Multimillion-Dollar Immersive Experience
item.description: The Preservation Society of Newport County has turned the Gilded Age mansion into a multi-sensory museum about the Berwind family and the staff who ran the house.

item.title: Rhode Island Today and Tonight: Frozen and Jazz
item.description: Tonight's best picks: Disney's Frozen at 7:30 PM in Woonsocket and Vincent Ingala at 8 PM in East Greenwich.

item.title: Trinity Rep's A Christmas Carol Celebrates Its 50th Anniversary
item.description: Trinity Repertory Company's 50th-anniversary A Christmas Carol runs through Dec. 31 at the Dowling Theater in Providence, directed by Taavon Gamble.

item.title: Newport's Jessica Hagen Gallery Opens Its 21st Holiday Show
item.description: The annual holiday exhibition opens with a reception from 5 to 7 PM on Saturday, Nov. 21, at 9A Bridge Street in Newport.

item.title: A Live Radio Play of It's a Wonderful Life Comes to Woonsocket
item.description: Thursday, Dec. 3 at 7:30 p.m., Saturday, Dec. 5 at 2 and 7:30 p.m., and Sunday, Dec. 6 at 2 p.m. at the Stadium Theatre in Woonsocket.

item.title: Foulkes Asks Quasi-Public Boards to Pause Executive Pay Deals Until January
item.description: The governor-elect called a new airport chief's pay package indefensible and promised a review of executive pay across Rhode Island's quasi-public agencies.

item.title: Fiber Internet Goes Live for First Newport Customers With $9 Million in State Aid
item.description: GoNetspeed has connected its first Newport homes and businesses to a fiber network backed by federal money routed through Rhode Island Commerce.

item.title: Newport Hospital Regains 'A' Safety Grade in Fall Leapfrog Ratings
item.description: The hospital climbed back from a B in the spring, joining Rhode Island Hospital and The Miriam with top marks from the national patient-safety group.

item.title: Alicia Keys' Hell's Kitchen Runs at PPAC Dec. 15 Through 20
item.description: Tuesday, Dec. 15 through Sunday, Dec. 20 at PPAC, 220 Weybosset Street, Providence, with evening and weekend matinee performances.

item.title: Foundry Artists' Holiday Show Brings 65 Artists to Pawtucket
item.description: Thursday, Dec. 3 at the Pawtucket Armory Center for the Arts, 172 Exchange Street, Pawtucket, with original art and handmade gifts.

item.title: Christmas in the Valley Brings Fine Art and Craft to Foster
item.description: Friday, Nov. 27 through Sunday, Nov. 29 at the Foster Country Club, 67 Johnson Road, Foster, with fine art and fine craft exhibitors.

item.title: Route 10 Traffic Shifts Begin in Providence and Cranston as Interchange Rebuild Moves On
item.description: RIDOT is moving Route 10 North onto a new bridge over Elmwood Avenue, with more lane changes and a weekend I-95 closure planned before the end of the year.

item.title: Central Falls High School Says Its Phone Rules Are Paying Off Under State Ban
item.description: A city that limited cell phones in class before the state acted says stricter enforcement this year is changing how students learn and talk.

item.title: RICCO Brings Handel's Messiah to All Saints in Providence
item.description: Saturday, Dec. 5, at 7 p.m. at All Saints Memorial Church in Providence, and Sunday, Dec. 6, at 3 p.m. at St. James Church in Manville.

item.title: State Ballet of Rhode Island's Coppélia Comes to Roberts Hall Dec. 12
item.description: Saturday, Dec. 12 at 2 p.m. in Roberts Hall Auditorium at Rhode Island College, Providence, with a pay-what-you-can dress rehearsal on Dec. 11.

item.title: Providence Opens Renovated Joslin Rec Center and New Olneyville Library
item.description: A $5.5 million project in Olneyville combines a renovated recreation center, a new library branch and a climate resilience hub.

item.title: Warren's Holiday Festival Brings a Full Friday of Family Fun, Nov. 27
item.description: Friday, Nov. 27, from 2:30 to 9 p.m. in downtown Warren, with the Main Street lighting at 7:15 p.m. at Town Hall.

item.title: Ocean State Artisans' Holiday Market Opens Thanksgiving Weekend in Wakefield

item.description: Open Wednesday through Monday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m., in the Cushing Gallery at the Newport Art Museum in Newport, through Dec. 31, 2027.

item.title: Peace Dale Congregational Church Holds Its 63rd Christmas Bazaar

item.description: Sunday, Dec. 13, 3 to 4 p.m., at St. Bernard Church in North Kingstown, with Catherine Gagnon conducting

item.title: The Newport Nutcracker Returns to Rosecliff Mansion for Late November
